name: corterra-book
description: Run your Corterra Book booking business from ChatGPT: set it up; add or change services, classes and products; build memberships, packs and combos; change your hours and closures; book and move appointments; fill quiet days; win back clients; and review the week. It works through your own account, asks before it saves anything, and never takes a payment.

interface.longDescription: Corterra Book is booking software for spas, saunas, massage therapists and studios. Connect it and ask in your own words: set up a new business or see what is already set up; add or change services, classes, add-ons and retail items; build memberships, packs and combos; change your hours, close for a day or part of a day, and set holidays; book, move, cancel and check in appointments; find quiet days and the regulars who could fill them; see who has drifted away and draft a win-back email for your review; and get a read on last week's bookings, new clients, no-shows and sales. It asks before it saves anything, and it can never charge a card, take a payment or issue a refund. You need a Corterra Book account, and you sign in with your dashboard login when you connect.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up my business
